description: This file defines a Symfony Console Command 'AddDataGroupCommand' used for adding data groups within the OrangeHRM system. It includes interactions for creating data groups, associating them with API permissions, and generating SQL scripts for database insertion.

classes.name: AddDataGroupCommand
classes.description: A Symfony Console Command class that facilitates adding data groups to the OrangeHRM system, including optional API permission associations and SQL script generation.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures command description, arguments, and options for adding data groups.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the SymfonyStyle object for interactive CLI input/output.

methods.name: interact
methods.description: Handles user interaction for inputting data group details, API information, and module selection.

methods.name: getModuleAutocompleteQuestion
methods.description: Creates an autocompleting question for selecting a module name.

methods.name: notBlankValidation
methods.description: Validates that a given input string is not blank.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that creates the data group, optionally associates API permissions, and outputs SQL scripts.

methods.name: printDataGroupTable
methods.description: Displays a table summarizing the created data group.

methods.name: printDataGroupSQL
methods.description: Outputs sample SQL insert statements for the data group.

methods.name: printApiPermissionTable
methods.description: Displays a table summarizing the API permission association.

methods.name: printApiPermissionSQL
methods.description: Outputs SQL to insert API permission data.

methods.name: printBlock
methods.description: Outputs a formatted block of SQL or message text.
